workshop_summary: Session 1 on one shared Nordic customer service: system, language, opening hours and measurement (transcript in Danish).

decisions.decision: One shared ticket system for the Group, with customers served in their own language by local staff
Minimum opening hours until 18:00 on weekdays in all countries; markets can extend at their own cost
Use the same customer satisfaction measure in all countries

open_issues.issue: Whether to outsource Finnish weekend cover to an external partner
Which customer satisfaction measure to use

actions.action: Prepare an options paper on outsourcing Finnish weekend cover
Investigate an interim solution for the ticket system before CRM consolidation
Lead communication to staff about the shared team
Create shared response templates and a knowledge base
Choose the common customer satisfaction measure

risks.risk: Staff in the small Swedish and Finnish teams fear job cuts
Outsourcing weekend cover lowers service quality
The ticket system is delayed until CRM consolidation in Q2

dependencies.depends_on: CRM consolidation in Q2 next year
